propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ diagnostic families must be enabled in the global ratchet configuration only after all 6 current diagnostics (3 in src/rebar, 3 in tests) are resolved to zero across src/rebar and tests.

Timestamp validation semantics must explicitly use UTC: epoch seconds converted with datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(created, tz=datetime.timezone.utc) and timezone-less persisted strings assigned datetime.timezone.utc before clustering.
Security-pin cadence logic must obtain an aware current instant with explicit timezone argument, convert to host timezone, and extract local calendar date while passing DTZ005 compliance.
The literal token datetime.UTC is prohibited; all production UTC construction must use datetime.timezone.utc because target-version is py310.

tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py must be created as owner of the shared Ruff configuration contract, asserting ASYNC and DTZ selection, absence of security selector S, and absence of datetime.UTC tokens in src/rebar Python files.

Timezone invariance must be proven by running validation behavior under at least two distinct TZ environment values on platforms supporting time.tzset(), with test skipped on Windows where tzset is unavailable.
